$comment: Root ADR-0475 (amends ADR-0355 §3). The 주소정보 전자지도 daily changes from the official 데이터 연계 (변동자료 연계서비스) of 주소기반산업지원서비스: one approval key (config/runtime-secrets.contract.json group juso, FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_JUSO_APP_KEY) and one URL, update.juso.go.kr/updateInfo.do, asked per request code (cntc_cd) and day. The collector (`collect-juso-electronic-map` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher) and the Silver load read this file; nothing else restates these values. The wire format, request codes, members and columns are the provider's public guide (`guide`), read 2026-11-10; the error answer was measured the same day (no key: HTTP 200, header err_code E0001 and approval_yn N, empty body). Sizes are not measured yet: the first run with the key is the measurement (root ADR-0457).
user_agent: foundation-platform-juso-electronic-map-collector/1 (+root ADR-0475; daily changes, one window per request)

query.$comment: Guide §3.1. date_gb D: the map files are daily-change only (the guide's 주요입력파라미터: 매칭데이터 및 지도 자료는 D만 가능). retry_in Y: the re-reflected files (재반영) come with the daily ones; each says so in its header (retry). req_dt/req_dt2 are always sent: without them the server picks the window from its own last-delivery record and answers P1000 (nothing) to a second ask the same day, so a lost run would lose its files. With them the ask is a pure function of the window and can be repeated.

answer.$comment: Guide §3.2 and the provider's own client (ADSClient-1.1.jar, kr.go.ads.client.ADSReceiver.makeReceiveData, read 2026-11-11). The body is a run of total_count records (the response header count_header). A record is a 100-byte header, then the file (a zip) of the header's size. The header's fields are fixed-width ASCII at these byte offsets (start inclusive, end exclusive); the rest of the 100 bytes is padding. A record whose file_name is blank holds no file: it is one day's own answer (its result_code, e.g. E1001 for a day without a file) and no bytes follow it, whatever its file_size says — the provider's client skips the body exactly so. The first run with the key (2026-11-10 21:14Z, windows from 2020-01-01) failed on all four codes on the first header, whose size read as a number and whose file_name was blank: such a record, read as a file (the raw answer was not kept; the next run keeps any it cannot read). A refused answer is HTTP 200 with the response header err_code and an empty body (measured 2026-11-10). An answer the collector cannot read is kept whole up to quarantine_bytes as a dead letter in the run directory before the run fails (W61).

result_codes.$comment: Guide §3.3. ok: the files are in the body. no_files: nothing for the window (a day the provider made no file: weekends, holidays, a kind with no change); the window is done. refused: the key or the code is not ours — the run stops asking at once, lands nothing more, and fails so the unit's OnFailure raises the alert (root ADR-0445); the next scheduled run asks again by itself, so no file has to be removed by a person (root ADR-0475 §4). ours: a request this collector built wrong; the run fails the same way. provider: the provider's own failure; that request code stops for this run and the window is asked again next run.

backfill.$comment: Each request code keeps its own cursor (the next day to ask, in the state directory); a run asks its windows oldest first, max_window_days days each, up to yesterday in KST (today's files are made after 07:00 KST and a window holding today could miss them). first_day is the start of the history the daily changes are kept for (a public implementer read files back to 2020; a window answered E1001 moves the cursor on). The per-run cap is max_windows_per_run windows that held a file per request code and max_bytes_per_run over the whole run; a window without a file (one answer of 100 B per day, 1,000 B a window) is bounded only by the run's time: the codes take run_time_budget_seconds in turn, the n-th of N codes starting no window after n/N of it has passed, so time a code leaves goes to the next and none is starved. Measured 2026-11-10 23:30Z (the first run that read its answers): 120 windows, all of 2020-01-01..2020-10-26 and every day E1001, in 366 s, 3.05 s an ask at the 3 s spacing; under the old cap of 30 windows of any kind that history alone would have taken about 8 more daily runs to cross without landing a file (W61). 251 windows per code from first_day to 2026-11-09, 1,004 asks, take about 3,062 s, inside the 3,600 s budget; the ask in flight at the deadline (request_timeout_seconds) and its landing still end well inside the unit's 7,200 s. The cursor stops where the run stopped, so the next run goes on from there.

base.$comment: Root ADR-0494. The daily changes carry no full set (guide: 초기자료 구축 is the separate full data), so each kind's Silver starts from one base: the 월전체 (monthly full set) of the 주소정보 다운로드 item 도로명주소 전자지도 (item). Read 2026-11-11 from the provider's own download page API (business.juso.go.kr /api/jst/selectBabsRtlDtaDtlList, /api/jst/selectAttrbDBDwldList): item 26 offers only 전체분 (APLY_DTA_SE_CD 11) per month, by 시도 or 전국, history 201601 on, the latest month on 2026-11-11 being 202610 (202611 not yet made); RLS_YN N: downloading needs a login, an application and the approval of the agency holding the region, so no job can ask for it. It is asked once: the base month and every daily change from replay_from on make the current state, so no later month is needed. Measured 2026-11-11 on the 202610 전국 download as placed (W61c): 16 zips, one per 시도 (서울특별시.zip … 전북특별자치도.zip, 4,591,506,695 bytes), each holding one folder <시도코드>/ (11000 … 52000; 12000 is 전남광주통합특별시) with the .shp, .shx and .dbf of the 11 layers below, beside GRS80_UTMK.prj and a layout PDF at the top: 35 members, no .cpg (the DBF text is CP949, language driver 0). A zip is placed, as downloaded, under inbox/<YYYYMM>/. The collector's run lands it once, byte for byte, in the one Bronze source of the base (source; operation juso_electronic_map_base, period YYYY-MM, key named by its SHA-256): the provider's bytes are kept once, not once per kind. Before landing, the run reads the zip's directory and refuses a zip that does not hold every layer's layer_parts in one <시도코드>/ folder; the members each kind reads are written in the run's request_params (juso_base.members) and in the state marker, and measure-bronze-object-members records the whole directory beside the ledger (root ADR-0169 §1), so a kind's Silver opens only its own members of each zip, by ranged reads. A landed zip is recorded under the state directory's base/ so a later run opens only zips it has not landed; the inbox is never written or emptied. A file that is not a zip, a zip without the layers, or a folder that is not a month fails the run and stays where it is. Silver per kind: that kind's layer (layers) in the base month, then every daily change whose base_date is on or after replay_from, in base_date then created_date order, keyed by the kind's key; replay_from is the first day of the month replay_overlap_months before the base month (202610: 2026-09-01), so whatever day the provider cut the full set on, no change after it is missed, and the overlap is safe because a change is the whole row (or a removal by key), so replaying one the base already holds gives the same row. building_group has no layer: the base's TL_SPBD_EQB is the 건물군 outline (columns EQB_MAN_SN, SIG_CD, OPERT_DE), not the linkage's 상세주소 동 (TI_SGCO_RNADR_DONG); it stays in Bronze and is named in unmatched_layers. Each kind's legal_code follows views.changed_codes like the changes (root ADR-0329 §3).

keys.$comment: The key of a kind's base rows where the layer does not carry the linkage key (kinds.*.key). Measured 2026-11-11 on the 202610 national set (W61c): every other kind's key is unique across its layer as it stands; TL_SPBD_BULD has no ADR_MNG_NO and its SIG_CD+RN_CD+BULD_SE_CD+BULD_MNNM+BULD_SLNO repeats 4,269,964 times (buildings sharing one road address), while BD_MGT_SN (건물관리번호) is unique over its 10,684,580 rows.

kinds.$comment: The 11 kinds of the endpoint catalog (group juso_electronic_map_bulk, Bronze source jusogokr__<kind>). A kind is one or more tables of one request code's file. A received file lands once in the Bronze of every kind its request code serves, byte for byte as the provider sent it (same SHA-256), so each kind's Silver reads only its own source (the owner's partial rule) and no file is cut apart before Bronze. Inside the zip a table is the members <AlterD>.<document_code>.<YYYYMMDD>.<table>.shp/.shx/.dbf and its removals <...>.<table>.Deletion.TXT (the removed rows' primary key only, guide p.34). key is the table's primary key (guide pp.54–71); legal_code is the column that places the row under a 법정동 code (the whole code or its 시도·시군구 prefix), which a code change moves (root ADR-0329 §3). Geometry is EPSG:5179.
